title: Removed silent eligibility rules from deterministic screens
points: ROIC, dividend-yield, and free-cash-flow-yield screens no longer silently blacklist whole tickers through broad or old quality flags; quality metadata now has to overlap the selected input row's ticker, table, metric, and period.

FCF-yield rankings no longer impose hidden market-cap, sector, age, positive-FCF, or 100% yield gates, and dividend-yield rankings no longer impose fixed 45-day, 550-day, positive-only, or 50% filters.

ROIC now carries the reported taxation and capital inputs needed by its stated formula, accepts explicit one-year and longer horizons without clamping them to three through ten years, preserves signed results, and requires only one formula-valid period.
The low-debt and positive-operating-cash-flow screen now ranks positive-CFO companies by leverage instead of inventing a debt-to-equity cutoff of 0.5.
Model forecasts retain historical assumptions without hidden runtime clamps, while missing-history template or industry defaults remain disclosed scenario assumptions.
Selector handoffs now follow typed dependency IDs rather than interpreting words such as selected, winner, or ranked in ask prose.
